# House style notes

Short sentences. One idea each.

Prefer the concrete noun over the abstract one: "the bucket nobody opens" beats
"suboptimal data accessibility". Name the thing.

Never open on process. Open on the finding, then say how it was found. A reader
who has to wade through methodology to reach the claim will not reach the claim.

Em-dashes are overused in this house. Commas and full stops do the work.
